variants.title: 方案 A · 团队会话
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity desktop application UI concept screenshot for Agent Hub, a local app where users connect their existing full AI agents and collaborate with them. Flat front-on actual UI design, very wide landscape approximately 1920x1200, large crisp legible simplified Chinese typography, premium carefully designed product, restrained spacing and realistic density. Not a website landing page, no marketing slogans, no device mockup, no perspective, no floating 3D elements. Use exactly the brand "Agent Hub". A small understated "设计预览 · 示例任务" label makes clear this is a concept with demonstration content. All 3 design alternatives use the same scenario: user asks for 3 AI content ideas, with original sources, then one short Chinese social post. Agent names are Grok, Muse, Gemini; these are existing personal agents, NOT arbitrary job roles. Show concrete useful collaboration, context handoff and readable deliverables. Do not show technical API keys, MCP configuration, token usage, fake performance metrics, browser login admin, earnings, charts, dashboards full of KPIs, or giant empty welcome screens. Use just enough short Chinese copy to make the interaction clear. High-quality finished Figma-level UI, clear visual hierarchy, precise alignment, icon consistency, sophisticated restrained borders and radii. Each generation is a complete single design, NOT a collage of alternatives. Design alternative A: TEAM CONVERSATION, a sophisticated collaboration room inspired by excellent team messaging tools. Light main canvas, warm near-white, deep slate narrow left sidebar, restrained cornflower-blue accent, absolutely no neon. Three functional regions: narrow sidebar about 230px with Agent Hub logo, "+ 新建工作", work conversations including selected "AI 选题周报", "竞品体验整理", and connected member list with small avatars Grok / Muse / Gemini. Main middle column about 820px is a continuous group conversation titled "AI 选题周报", with a compact avatar stack in header. User message: "@Grok 找 3 个值得写的 AI 实操案例，@Muse 整理成中文选题。". Grok reply visually contains 3 compact source cards and a tasteful inline event "Grok 已把 3 份资料交给 Muse" with avatar-to-avatar indication. Muse reply starts "整理好了，建议优先写第 2 个。" and shows a clean deliverable card titled "AI 实操选题 · 3 个方向". Another user follow-up "第二个展开，少讲概念，多讲怎么做。" Rich bottom composer with attachment icon, "@ 提及成员", placeholder "跟团队说点什么…", send arrow. No oversized chat bubbles; refined editorial messages. Right column about 430px is an actual readable artifact preview titled "选题与素材", with tabs "成果" / "来源" / "进度", a clean mini document with 3 short numbered ideas ("收藏变选题", "浏览器自动实操", "Agent 分工写作"), source link chips and button "打开完整文稿". Show subtle active state "Muse 正在修改文稿" adjacent to its message, not a giant progress dashboard. Top left of screenshot small label "A / 团队会话". This should feel like actually managing a team through one shared conversation, immediately usable without understanding task software.
